verdict.rationale: Keycloak's Server Administration Guide documents the OAuth 2.0 device authorization grant for clients with limited input or no suitable browser, which covers CLIs and headless agents. The OIDC layers reference documents the device endpoint (/realms/{realm}/protocol/openid-connect/auth/device), which issues the device and user codes. This lets these clients get user-delegated tokens instead of embedding long-lived secrets. Missing for 10: deeper evidence on per-client enablement, polling and expiry configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the device flow in CLI or agent use.
